# paperclip_plugin (Resource)

Manages installation and lifecycle of Paperclip plugins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_plugin" "linear" {
  package_name     = "@paperclipai/plugin-linear"
  version          = "1.0.0"
  enabled          = true
  purge_on_destroy = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `package_name` (String) Install source: npm package name (e.g. @paperclip/plugin-linear) or local filesystem path. Local source changes use an in-place native upgrade, retaining the plugin ID and configuration. Import restores the API's installed packagePath.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is enabled and in ready status. Defaults to true.
- `is_local_path` (Boolean) Whether package_name is a local filesystem path.
- `purge_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether to permanently purge all plugin data upon uninstallation (defaults to false).
- `version` (String) Plugin semver version. Changing this triggers an in-place upgrade.

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (Number) Plugin API version declared in the manifest.
- `id` (String) Plugin UUID identifier.
- `last_error` (String) Most recent error message or disable reason.
- `plugin_key` (String) Unique key derived from the plugin manifest id.
- `status` (String) Current lifecycle status (ready, installed, disabled, upgrade_pending, error, uninstalled).
- `upgrade_pending` (Boolean) True if the plugin is in upgrade_pending status awaiting capability approval.
